note: The four owner-approved source repositories. Each is fetched read-only into upstream/<name>/ at exactly this commit by scripts/upstream_sync.py. JINX never edits upstream files; it reaches them only through jinx/adapters/<name>/.

gmgn.role: Data intelligence and approved GMGN API capabilities (token, market, wallet, tracking, trade API client). Does not decide entries or exits.

mako.role: Trading infrastructure: discovery, event feeds, wallet observation, persistence and risk-monitoring mechanics. Its wallet score, entry policy, sizing defaults and exit ladders are NOT used.

d3ad.role: Fast execution: transaction construction, submission, confirmation and reconciliation (Phase 3). Executes JINX decisions; never sets strategy.

datanomad.role: Historical intelligence research. No license file at this commit, so no code may be copied into JINX; methodology reference only until the author grants permission.
